Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 or FIX.4.4 Must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following Body Length field up to and including the delimiter preceding the Check Sum (10) field. Must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Defaults to N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender. Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (Target Comp ID (56) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT date and time that message was sent. Nanosecond level reso- lution.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination. BATS for messages sent to TRF ports. (Sender Comp ID (49) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination. TEST for messages sent to the Cboe test system. PROD for messages sent to the Cboe production system. (Sender- Sub ID (50) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Possible resend flag. Cboe does not support Poss Resend (97) = Y on the TRF system.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with Poss Dup Flag (43) = Y, indicates time that mes- sage was first sent. Nanosecond level resolution.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on message from Cboe. Must be Cboe approved identifier.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in the message up to and including the delimiter preceding the Check Sum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is included when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by Cboe for the given symbol.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by the TRF: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: For Trade Capture Reportssubmittedtothe EUAPAvenue,Last Mkt shouldbeusedtospecify MICcodewhenthetradingvenueisanon- EU equivalent venue under ESMA rules. For Trade Capture Reports performed on a Systematic Internaliser (SI), i.e. Match Type (574) = 9 (Systematic Internalizer), Last Mkt should be used to submit the 4-character MIC code of the SI. The MIC will be validated against the applicable ESMA / FCA registries.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Traded price. A value of zero or an indicative price may be used if the price is pending, as denoted by Trade Price Condition. This tag may be excluded if using Gross Trade Amt.

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity (eg. shares) traded.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Optional,when Trade Report Trans Type (487)=0. Indicatesthedate and time the trade took place. Nanosecond level resolution.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Optional. If specified, must match the date component of Transact- Time (60).

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Must be F = Trade

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Usedwhen IDSource (22)=4(ISIN)toidentifyaspecificmarket. If presentmustbeavalid Reutersexchangecodeor ISOMICcode. For APA trade reports, may optionally be left blank to use the primary line as designated by Cboe.

Field.Name: GrossTradeAmt
Field.Description: Total amount traded, expressed in units of currency. A value of of zero or an indicative total amount traded price may be used if the priceispending,asdenotedby Trade Price Condition. Thistagisonly considered when Last Px is not specified. Supports a maximum of 9 digits before decimal.

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Specifies whether this trade report is new, a cancellation, an amend- ment or a release. Trades reported under the APA service may be cancelled or amended by the participant. Trades that are currently being delayed from publication can be released for immediate publi- cation. Defaults to ‘new’ if unspecified. 0 = New 1 = Cancel 2 = Replace 3 = Release

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. Cboe will enforce port level day- uniqueness. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. If the Trade Report ID matches a live trade report (one that has been acked,butnotconfirmedordeclined),itwillberejectedasduplicate. When it comes to day-uniqueness, Trade Report ID of trade reports that were published are considered used, and cannot be used in a new trade report. Forexample, atradereportfromthepreviousday, deferredandpub- lished today at noon, as soon as this trade report is published, its Trade Report ID cannot be used for new trade reports. Similarly, a trade report that was submitted after hours, when it subsequently gets published at open, its Trade Report ID cannot be used for new trade reports either.

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Where Venue Type (1430)=O(offbook),thisfieldmodelsthe MMT Level 2 ‘Trading Mode’ field, and takes the following values: 1 = Trade Reporting (Off-Exchange) 3 = Trade Reporting (On-Exchange) 9 = Trade Reporting (Systematic Internalizer)

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.1 field ‘Transaction Cat- egory’. 0 = Regular Trade (when none of the following applies) 2 = Exchange For Physicals (XFPH), for RTS 2 non-equities only 50 = Portfolio Trade Refer to p. 5 for more details. This corre- spondsto MMTLevel3.11field‘Portfolio’,PORT.Shouldonly be set to this value when used in conjunction with Secondary- Trd Type (855) = 64 (BENC) and Tertiary Trd Type (2896) = 65 (CONT). 62 = Dark Trade 65 = Package Trade (TPAC) which are not Exchange for Physicals (XFPH), for RTS 2 non-equities only. Use 2 if it’s Exchange for Physicals (XFPH) If Trade Price Condition(1839)=14(Tradewith Price Improvement) isspecified,thenthevaluespecifiedin Trd Type (828)willbeignored. Trade with Price Improvement takes precedence above the values listed here.

Field.Name: SecondaryTrdType
Field.Description: This optional field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.5 field ‘Bench- mark Indicator’(BENC).Benchmarktradesmaybeindicatedbyset- ting Secondary Trd Type (855) = 64. Other values are invalid. Refer to p. 5 for more details 50 = Portfolio Trade (MMT Level 3.11 field ‘Portfolio’, PORT) - Effective1December2025,on UKAPA,ifthisissetfora RTS 2 non-equity along with Package Trade ( Trd Type (828) = 65 ), the PORT value will be ignored, as TPAC and PORT are mutually exclusive. 61=RFMDGive-up Trade(MMTLevel3.13field‘Give-up’,GIVE) 64 = Benchmark (MMT Level 3.5 field ‘Benchmark Indicator’, BENC) 65 = Contingent Transaction (RTS 1 equities only) (MMT Level 3.12 field ‘Contingent’, CONT) 67 = Benchmark Transactions Executed At the Market Close Price (MMT Level 3.5 field ‘Benchmark At Market Close Price’, CLSE) (Supported in UK APA, RTS 1 equities only). This cannot be used in conjunction with Trd Reg Publication Reasons (8013) = 3: Reference Price (Dark Book) (for MTF only) (RFPT)

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Must be 0 (Submit)

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Usedtospecifyapreviouslyreportedtradetobeamended, cancelled or released. Mandatory when Trade Report Trans Type (487) = 1, 2 or 3, must be absent when Trade Report Trans Type (487) = 0.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Must be 1 (Two-Party Report)

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: Thisfieldcorrespondstothe MMTLevel4.1field’Publication Mode’, and can be used by the participant to request that the publication be delayed. It is ignored if the trade does not qualify for delayed publication. This field may not be amended, however trades currently being de- layed may be released prior to their maximum delay duration using Trade Report Trans Type (487) = 3. Supported values: 0 = Do Not Publish 1 = Publish trade (immediately) 2 = Deferred Publication

Field.Name: VenueType
Field.Description: Indicates the type of venue on which this trade occurred. This field models the MMT Level 1 field ‘Market Mechanism’, and has the following possible values: B = Central Limit Order Book Q = Quote Driven Market D = Dark Order Book O = Off Book A = Periodic Auctions N = Request for Quotes H = Hybrid Market z = Other (Excluding Hybrid)

Field.Name: NoTradePriceConditions
Field.Description: Ifpresent,indicatesthenumberof Trade Price Condition(1839)fields.

Field.Name: TradePriceCondition
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate values in MMT v3 levels 3.6 and 3.8 For MMTLevel3.6‘Special Divided Indicator’,supportedvaluesare: 13 = Special Dividend (SDIV) For MMT Level 3.8 ‘Contribution to Price Formation or the Price Discovery Process’, supported values are: 16 = Trade not Contributing to the Price Discovery Process (TNCP) (Invalid for EU APA). 17 = Price is Pending (PNDG)

Field.Name: IntraFirmTradeIndicator
Field.Description: Thisfieldindicatesifatransactionisbetweenentitieswithinthesame groupcarriedoutforintragroupriskmanagementpurposestotrans- fer risk accumulated as a result of previously executed transactions or where necessary to comply with regulatory requirements (IGRP). N = Not an intra-group transaction (default) Y = Is an intra-group transaction

Field.Name: ExecMethod
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate that the method by which the trade was executed. This field corresponds to the proposed MMT Level 3.7 ‘Offbook Automated Liquidity Indicator’. The following values are supported: 0 = Unspecified (default) 1 = Manual 2 = Automated

Field.Name: AlgorithmicTradeIndicator
Field.Description: Indicatesthatthesubmittedtradewasaresultofaninvestmentfirm engaging in algorithmic trading. Optional. 0 = No algorithm was involved (the default). 1 = The trade was an algorithmic trade (ALGO).

Field.Name: TertiaryTrdType
Field.Description: Refer to p. 5 formore details 50 = Portfolio Trade (MMT Level 3.11 field ‘Portfolio’, PORT) - Effective1December2025,on UKAPA,ifthisissetfora RTS 2 non-equity along with Package Trade ( Trd Type (828) = 65 ), the PORT value will be ignored, as TPAC and PORT are mutually exclusive. 61=RFMDGive-up Trade(MMTLevel3.13field‘Give-up’,GIVE) 64 = Benchmark (MMT Level 3.5 field ‘Benchmark Indicator’, BENC) 65 = Contingent Transaction (RTS 1 equities only) (MMT Level 3.12 field ‘Contingent’, CONT) 67 = Benchmark Transactions Executed At the Market Close Price (MMT Level 3.5 field ‘Benchmark At Market Close Price’, CLSE) (Supported in UK APA, for RTS 1 equities only). This cannot be used in conjunction with Trd Reg Publication Reasons (8013) = 3: Reference Price (Dark Book) (for MTF only) (RFPT)

Field.Name: MultiJurisdictionReportingIndica
Field.Description: to Trhis field indicates that trade eligible for being reported more than once due to overlapping regulatory reporting rules in different juris- dictions (XBDT). 0 = This trade is not reported in more than one jurisdiction. (de- fault) 1 = This trade is reported in multiple jurisdictions.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublication Reasons
Field.Description: Optional,toindicate MMTWaiversand Deferralsusedforthetrade. Valid values are: 0 = Negotiated Trade in Liquid Instrument (for MTF only) (NLIQ) 1=Negotiated Tradein Illiquid Instrument(for MTFonly)(OILQ) 2 = Negotiated Trade Subject to Conditions Other Than Current Market Price (for MTF only) (PRIC) 3 = Reference Price (Dark Book) (for MTF only) (RFPT) 6 = Deferral for Large in Scale (LRGS) 17=Negotiated Trade Subjecttoa Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver (replaces NLIQ, OLIQ, and PRIC) (for MTF only) (NETW) 9 = Negotiated Trade Larger Than LIS brought onto a venue for which Pre-Trade transparency can be waived (NTLS) (for UK MTF only) 24=Deferralfortransactionsin ETCs,ETNs,etc(for RTS2only), only applicable on EU APA (DEFF) 99 = Indicates a Net Asset Value (NAV) Trade. Cboe will publish suchtradesimmediatelyonreceiptandtheywillnotbeconsid- ered as late reporting, regardless of the arrangement time on the message. Negotiated Trade Indicatorsand Pre-Trade Transparency Waiversare MMT Level 3.2 values. Reference Price is a MMT Level 3.5 value. Deferral Reasons are MMT Level 4.1 values. Deferral Reasons are represented by MMT Levels 4.3, and 4.4, in addition to Level 4.1. Multiple values can be supplied in a space separated list. Not all combinations are valid. The Negotiated Trade Indicators (NLIQ, OILQ, PRIC and NETW) and Reference Price Waiver(RFPT)are MTFOnlyandareallmutally exclusive (i.e. only one value can be supplied). For MTFreportingto UKAPA,thenew Negotiated Trade Subjectto a Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver(NETW)shouldbeusedinsteadof NLIQ, OLIQ and PRIC. NETW should not be used before that date. The Pre-Trade Transparency Waivers ILQD and SIZE are SI Only and can be requested individually or together (e.g. 4 5). Thebusinessconfirmationcontainsthewaiver(s)anddeferral(s)that have been appplied.

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: This optional field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.3 field ‘Agency Cross Trade Indicator’ (ACTX). Agency Cross trades may be indi- cated by setting Trd Sub Type (829) = 37. This is deprecated. Other values are invalid.

Field.Name: TradePriceCondition
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate values in MMT v3 level 3.1 ‘Transaction Category’: 14 = Trade with Price Improvement (RPRI). Trd Type (828) = 0 should be set.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublication Reasons
Field.Description: Optional,toindicate MMTWaiversand Deferralsusedforthetrade. 4 = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Illiquid Instrument (for SI only) (ILQD) 5 = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Above Standard Market Size (for SI only) (SIZE) 7 = Deferral for Illiquid Instrument (for RTS2 only) (ILQD) 8 = Deferral for Size Specific (for RTS2 only) (SIZE) The Deferral Reasons can be supplied individually or in a space sep- arated list. LRGS and SIZE are mutually exclusive and so (6 8) is invalid.

Field.Name: QuoteID
Field.Description: Mandatory unique ID chosen by client for a Quote or Quote Cancel. 18 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of Quote ID values amongcurrentlylivequotes. However,westronglyrecommend that you keep your Quote ID values day unique.

Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of Quote ID values amongcurrentlylivequotes. However,westronglyrecommend that you keep your Quote ID values day unique.
